title: docs: replace the generated README with a project README
author: Philipp Klinger
patch:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
@@ -1,39 +1,24 @@
-# Videoflix
+# Videoflix Frontend
 
-This project was generated with [Angular CLI](https://github.com/angular/angular-cli) version 16.2.12.
+Single-page web app for Videoflix, a small video streaming platform: sign up and log in, browse the catalog, watch HLS streams, and upload your own clips. It talks to the Django REST API in [videoflix-backend](https://github.com/PhilippKlinger/videoflix-backend).
 
-## Development server
+## Stack
 
-Run `ng serve` for a dev server. Navigate to `http://localhost:4200/`. The application will automatically reload if you change any of the source files.
+- Angular 22.2 with standalone components, Angular Material 22.2
+- TypeScript 6.0, RxJS 7.8
+- hls.js 1.7 for playback
+- Karma and Jasmine for unit tests, Playwright for end-to-end tests
 
-## Code scaffolding
+## Commands
 
-Run `ng generate component component-name` to generate a new component. You can also use `ng generate directive|pipe|service|class|guard|interface|enum|module`.
+```bash
+npm ci          # install dependencies
+npm start       # dev server on http://localhost:4200, proxies /api to the backend (proxy.conf.json)
+npm test        # unit tests
+npm run build   # production build, output in dist/videoflix/browser
+npm run e2e     # Playwright tests (need a running backend)
+```
 
-## Build
+## Deployment
 
-Run `ng build` to build the project. The build artifacts will be stored in the `dist/` directory.
-
-## Running unit tests
-
-Run `ng test` to execute the unit tests via [Karma](https://karma-runner.github.io).
-
-## Running end-to-end tests
-
-The end-to-end tests use [Playwright](https://playwright.dev) and run against the local dev stack:
-
-1. Start the backend with `docker compose --profile dev up -d` (includes Mailpit for the activation mails).
-2. Start the frontend with `npm start`.
-3. Once: `npx playwright install chromium`.

title: fix: rename version fields to the published contract
author: Philipp Klinger
patch:
diff --git a/Dockerfile b/Dockerfile
@@ -16,10 +16,10 @@ USER root
 RUN apk upgrade --no-cache
 COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
 COPY --from=build /app/dist/videoflix/browser/ /usr/share/nginx/html/
-# Public build info: commit and build time only, set by the CI.
+# Public build info (fields sha and builtAt): commit and build time only, set by the CI.
 ARG GIT_SHA=unknown
 ARG BUILD_TIME=unknown
-RUN printf '{"commit":"%s","build_time":"%s"}' "$GIT_SHA" "$BUILD_TIME" > /usr/share/nginx/html/version.json
+RUN printf '{"sha":"%s","builtAt":"%s"}' "$GIT_SHA" "$BUILD_TIME" > /usr/share/nginx/html/version.json
 # nginx-unprivileged runs as uid 101 and listens on 8080; stated explicitly so a base-image change cannot fall back to root.
 USER 101
 EXPOSE 8080

+      # A demo account only sees the standard catalog, which starts empty. The worker converts in the background.
+      - name: Seed the standard catalog

+          docker compose --profile dev cp ../e2e/fixtures/test-clip.mp4 web:/tmp/catalog/test-clip.mp4
